title: Beemaar ka matam hai
body:
BEEMAR KA MATAM HAI BEEMAR KI MATAM HAI
WO JISNE BHARE GHAT KOLUTEY HUE DEKHA HAI, JHULA ALI ASGAR KA JALTE HUE DEKHA HAI, MAA BEHNAU KO BE PARDA HOTE HUVE DEKHA HAI, US BEKAS –O- MUZTAR KA GHAM QWAR KA MATAM HAI
BE GOOR-O-KAFAN RAN ME SARWAR KA JANAZA THA, SAHIL KE KANARE PAR ABBAS KA LASHA THA, US KHOO BHARE MANZAR KO SAJJAD NE DEKHA THA, US BEKAS-O-MUZTAR KA GHAM QWAR KA MATAM HAI
HAR HUKM BAJA LAYA BABA KI WASIYATH PAR, TA UMR KIYA GIRYA SARWAR KI SHAHADATH PAR, SAB ROOTEY HAIN PARWANE AB JISKI MUSIBATHH PAR, USKE BEKAS-O-MUZTAR KAGHAM QWAR KA MATAM HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
JAB SHAAM KA NAAM AAYA ABID NE KAHA ROKAR, KIS TARHHA SE BHOOLONGA WO DARD BHARA MANZAR, ZEHRA KE GHARANA THA BE MAQNA-O-BE CHADAR, US BEKAS-O-MUZTAR KA GHAM QWAR KA MATAM HAI
HAR GAAM YEH ABID PAR ZULMAT KI GHATA CHAYI, HAIN BEDIYAAN PAIRAON MEIN DURRAON SE BADANZAKHMI, THA SHUKREY KHUDA JISKEY HONTAU PA SADA JAARI, US BEKAS-O-MUZTAR KA GHAM QWAR KA MATAM HAI
BE PARDA RASAN BASTA ZEHRA KI DULARI HAI, HAR SIMTH TAMASHHAYI ZILLATH YEHUTHAYI HAI, WO JISNE SAKINA KI TURBAT BHI BANAYI HAI, US BEKAS-O-MUZTAR KA GHAM QWAR KA MATAM HAI
GHAM AAJ BAPA SAB KO BEEMAAR KA KARNA HAI, AYE MOOSVI PURSA BHI SHABBIR KO DENA HAI, JO UTHH GAYA DUNIYA SE WO SHAH-E-MADINA HAI, US BEKAS-O-MUZTAR KA GHAM QWAR KA MATAM HAI..
